# IconButton

An action with no visible label. Every one of them carries a required `label`, because there is nothing else to announce.

## Anatomy

An `Icon` centred in a target at least 44px square.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` *(required)* | `IconName` | — | — |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | Required: an icon-only control has no other name. |
| `variant` | `'bare' \| 'circle'` | `'bare'` | `circle` is the reference's outlined 38px settings button; `bare` is its header icon. |
| `size` | `number` | `20` | — |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `onclick` | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` | — | — |
| `href` | `string` | — | — |

## Variants

`bare` is the reference's header icon; `circle` is its outlined settings button.

## States

Default, hover, focus-visible, disabled.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves to and from the control. |
| `Enter` | Activates; on a link variant, follows the link. |
| `Space` | Activates the button variant. |

## ARIA

`aria-label` is required by the type. The icon inside is decorative, so the label is announced once.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
